headlines.title_en: PBOC Shanghai HQ: Solidly implement moderately loose monetary policy, actively push financial institutions to tap effective credit demand
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Headquarters of the People's Bank of China held a 2026 second-half work conference on August 4. The meeting stressed that the Shanghai Headquarters should solidly implement a moderately loose monetary policy, actively encourage financial institutions to explore effective credit demand, and make good use of various structural monetary policy tools. It should implement the 'Five Major Financial Articles' 1+N series of policies, promote the sustained effectiveness of the 'Technology Board' in the bond market in Shanghai, steadily deepen financial reform and opening-up, build and improve the foreign exchange management system and mechanism, and implement new policies such as high-level opening-up of cross-border trade and investment financing, overseas lending, and overseas listings.

headlines.title_en: A-share market close: STAR 50 opened low and rallied, up 4.78%; chip and computing hardware stocks collectively strengthened
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market opened low and moved higher all day, with all three major indexes rising over 1% and the STAR 50 up nearly 5%. Semiconductor chip stocks continued to rebound, with Dawei Co., Jinhaitong, and Kangqiang Electronics hitting their daily limits. Computing hardware stocks rallied, with Foxconn Industrial Internet, Huilv Ecology, and Jin'an Guoji hitting their daily limits. Intelligent driving concepts were active, with Suoling Co., Zhejiang Shibao, and Xingmin Zhitong hitting their daily limits. Precious metals strengthened, with Sichuan Gold, Jinyi Culture, and Shengda Resources hitting their daily limits. Decliners outnumbered advancers slightly, with over 3,700 stocks rising across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing, and turnover reaching 2.68 trillion yuan. At the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.47%, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.86%, and the ChiNext rose 1.32%. 2. By sector, precious metals, semiconductor chips, computing hardware, and consumer electronics led gains, while banking, oil and gas, traditional Chinese medicine, and baijiu fell against the trend. 3. A total of 3,427 stocks rose across the two markets, with 103 falling.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title: 广州有银行住房商贷利率最低可至2.7% 分析人士：更像针对特定人群的“价格战”
headlines.summary: 目前多数城市已经取消了住房贷款利率下限，但仍维持在3%以上。广州此前便有银行将住房贷款下调至3%以下，随后均又调回3%。不过，汇丰银行广州分行称，住房贷款利率最低可至2.7%。“未来银行个人住房贷款利率大体上也不会降，3%基本上是底线了，只能说只针对部分特定客户可以给到2.7%。”上海易居房地产研究院副院长严跃进对记者表示，此类最低利率门槛很高，并非人人都能享受，更像是一种针对特定人群的“价格战”。（每经）

headlines.title_en: Some Guangzhou banks' housing commercial loan rates can go as low as 2.7%; analysts say it's more of a 'price war' targeting specific groups
headlines.summary_en: Most cities have lifted the lower limit on housing loan rates, but they remain above 3%. In Guangzhou, some banks previously cut housing loans below 3% but later raised them back. However, HSBC's Guangzhou branch said housing loan rates can be as low as 2.7%. 'In the future, banks' personal housing loan rates will generally not fall; 3% is basically the bottom line, and 2.7% can only be offered to specific clients,' said Yan Yuejin, deputy director of Shanghai E-House Real Estate Research Institute, noting that such minimum rates have high thresholds and are not available to everyone, more like a 'price war' targeting specific groups.

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM spokesperson answers questions on countermeasures against a series of negative China-related moves by U.S. FCC and DHS
headlines.summary_en: The US FCC's measures and the Department of Homeland Security's inclusion of relevant entities on the so-called 'Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act Entity List' seriously violate the important consensus reached by the two heads of state and severely damage China's legitimate rights and interests. China has no choice but to take necessary countermeasures, including strengthening export controls on drones and their key components and technologies to the US, suspending factory follow-up inspections implemented by US certification bodies under designated Chinese compulsory product certification bodies, adding US Compliance Testing Company to the countermeasures list, launching a foreign trade national security investigation into imported printing, copying, and office equipment, and adding six US entities to the countermeasures list.

headlines.title: 新宝股份：控股股东东菱集团拟增持不低于5000万元且不高于8000万元
headlines.summary: 新宝股份公告，控股股东广东东菱凯琴集团有限公司计划自本增持计划公告披露之日起六个月内，通过深圳证券交易所交易系统（包括但不限于集中竞价和大宗交易）增持公司股份，拟增持金额不低于人民币5000万元且不高于人民币8000万元。截至公告披露日，东菱集团直接持有公司股份3.55亿股，占公司总股本的43.67%；通过东菱电器集团有限公司间接持有公司股份1.84亿股，占公司总股本的22.64%；合计持有公司股份5.38亿股，占公司总股本的66.31%。

headlines.title_en: Xinbao Electrical: Controlling shareholder Dongling Group plans to increase holdings by no less than 50 million yuan and no more than 80 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: Xinbao Co. announced that its controlling shareholder, Guangdong Dongling Kaiqin Group Co., Ltd., plans to increase its shareholding in the company within six months from the date of this plan announcement through the Shenzhen Stock Exchange trading system (including but not limited to centralized bidding and block trading), with an intended increase amount of no less than RMB 50 million and no more than RMB 80 million. As of the announcement date, Dongling Group directly holds 355 million shares, accounting for 43.67% of the company's total shares; indirectly holds 184 million shares through Dongling Electric Appliance Group, accounting for 22.64%; and holds a total of 538 million shares, accounting for 66.31%.

headlines.title_en: Apple considers adding China's CXMT to new supply chain but price negotiation fails
headlines.summary_en: According to South Korean IT media Digital Daily, citing industry sources, Apple had considered adding China's CXMT to its new supply chain to cut costs, but has now encountered resistance in negotiations to further lower purchase prices. Apple recently negotiated supply prices for mobile DRAM such as LPDDR5X with CXMT to ease cost pressure on next-generation iPhones and other smart devices, but its price reduction demands were rejected. It is understood that CXMT's quote is even higher than Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, or at least at a similar level. Apple, which once had strong bargaining power in the consumer electronics market, has now hit a hard wall against firm supplier pricing. headlines.title: 商务部：对相关进口打印复印办公设备发起对外贸易国家安全立案调查
headlines.summary: 依据《中华人民共和国对外贸易法》第四十一条规定，为了维护对外贸易秩序，商务部可以自行或者会同国务院其他有关部门，就对外贸易中有关国家安全利益的事项进行调查。初步信息显示，装有外国系统软件的进口打印复印办公设备可能影响对外贸易中的国家安全利益，符合《中华人民共和国对外贸易法》第四十一条规定的情形。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Initiates national security investigation into imports of certain printing and copying office equipment
headlines.summary_en: Pursuant to Article 41 of the Foreign Trade Law of the People's Republic of China, in order to maintain foreign trade order, the Ministry of Commerce may, on its own or jointly with other relevant departments of the State Council, investigate matters related to national security interests in foreign trade. Preliminary information shows that imported printing, copying, and office equipment installed with foreign system software may affect national security interests in foreign trade, meeting the circumstances stipulated in Article 41 of the Foreign Trade Law.

headlines.title: 商务部：加强无人机相关两用物项对美国出口管制
headlines.summary: 根据《中华人民共和国出口管制法》和《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》等法律法规有关规定，为维护国家安全和利益、履行防扩散等国际义务，决定加强无人机相关两用物项对美国出口管制。现将有关事项公告如下：对列入《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》的无人机及其关键零部件、相关技术对美国出口，逐案从严审核，不适用许可便利措施。本公告自公布之日起正式实施。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Strengthens export controls on drone-related dual-use items to the U.S.
headlines.summary_en: In accordance with the Export Control Law of the People's Republic of China and the Regulations on Export Control of Dual-Use Items of the People's Republic of China and other relevant laws and regulations, and to safeguard national security and interests and fulfill international obligations such as non-proliferation, it is decided to strengthen export controls on drone-related dual-use items to the US. The following is hereby announced: Exports of drones and their key components and related technologies listed in the Dual-Use Items Export Control List of the People's Republic of China to the US will be strictly reviewed on a case-by-case basis, and licensing facilitation measures will not apply. This announcement takes effect from the date of publication.
